record.name: Yururon - AI Research Digest
record.offering: News app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Every morning, you will receive the latest research papers from around the world, gently summarized by AI.

Yururon is a research paper reader that uses AI to provide easy-to-read summaries of carefully selected noteworthy papers from sources like arXiv. You can catch up on the latest research developments in just 3 minutes every day, without being intimidated by technical jargon.

■ AI simplifies research paper summaries
AI organizes and delivers not only the abstract but also key points on the background, methodology, and results. You can read and understand fields outside your expertise in accessible language.

■ Discover your interests across 4 categories
・Latest: New arrivals from all fields in chronological order
・Discovery: Random suggestions of unread papers
・AI / Medicine / Life Science / Psychosocial: Feeds by field

■ Daily New Arrival Notifications
Receive a notification once a day featuring recommended papers for that day. You can toggle this on or off at any time from Settings.

■ Bookmarks and Read Status Management
Save papers you are interested in and look back on them later. Papers you have read will be marked as read.

■ AI-generated hero images
Concept art that visualizes the content of the paper, allowing you to grasp the atmosphere at a glance even in list views.

■ One-tap access to the original paper
If the summary sparks your interest, you can access the original paper with a single tap.

- Recommended for:
・Those who want to keep up with the latest research but lack the time to read academic papers
・Those interested in fields outside their own expertise
・Those looking for intellectual stimulation during commutes, school travel, or breaks
・Students, researchers, engineers, and business professionals

- Terms of Use
・The summary is generated by AI. Please be sure to check the original paper before citing or making decisions.
・Information in the medical and life sciences category does not replace medical advice. Please consult a medical professional for diagnosis and treatment.
・Browsing and notifications are available without signing in. Signing in is required only for saving bookmarks.

Privacy Policy : https://yururon.app/PrivacyPolicy/English

record.name: Otto - AI Car Buying Expert
record.offering: Shopping app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
MEET OTTO

The car expert in your pocket. Scan any used car listing and Otto reveals everything you should know before you buy.

Reveal known issues, upcoming repairs, and discover which car is right for you. Otto even helps you negotiate the price and help you out smart dealer tactics. It's like bringing a car expert with you to the dealer.

SCAN ANY USED CAR

Found a car you are interested in? Otto makes researching it simple.

- Paste a used car listing
- Take photos of a used car
- Scan screenshots of a listing

Otto gets to work researching the vehicle and turns complicated information into a simple report you can actually understand.

GET YOUR OTTO DEAL SCORE

Not every good looking car is a good deal.

Otto analyzes available vehicle information, pricing, mileage, market data, reliability information, and other factors to create an easy to understand Deal Score.
Quickly see how a vehicle stacks up and whether it looks like a great find or deserves a closer look.

KNOW BEFORE YOU BUY

The asking price is only part of the story. Otto helps surface important information that could affect your decision, including:
- Fair market value
- Known issues
- Reliability insights
- Recall information
- Pricing insights
- Mileage considerations
- Ownership considerations
- Listing details
- Potential concerns
- Questions to ask the seller

Otto takes all of that information and explains it in plain language so you can understand why it matters.

REVEAL THE TRUTH BEHIND ANY USED CAR

A listing is designed to sell you the car. Otto is designed to help you research it.

A vehicle might look perfect in photos while having a model year known for expensive repairs. Another might look overpriced until you discover it has valuable options, unusually low mileage, or a configuration that commands a premium.

RESEARCH WITHOUT THE RABBIT HOLE

Used car research can quickly turn into dozens of browser tabs.
- What is this car worth?
- Is this model reliable?
- Are there known problems?
- Is the mileage high?
- What should I inspect?
- How much should I offer?

Otto helps answer those questions in one place.

FIND YOUR NEXT CAR

Do not have a specific vehicle yet?

Use Otto to search for used cars and discover vehicles near you. When something catches your eye, Otto can help you dig deeper before you decide whether it is worth pursuing.

SHOP FROM ANYWHERE

Otto is built for the way people actually shop for cars.

- Research a listing from your couch
- Scan screenshots while browsing
- Pull up Otto while walking around a dealership
- Research a vehicle before contacting the seller

BUILD YOUR GARAGE

Save vehicles to your Otto Garage so you can keep the cars you are considering organized and easily return to their reports.
Your Garage becomes your personal shortlist while you shop.

NEGOTIATE WITH CONFIDENCE

Finding the right car is only half the battle. Then you have to negotiate. Otto looks for information that could help you better understand the deal and identify potential negotiating opportunities. It can also help you prepare questions to ask the seller or dealer so you walk into the conversation informed.

YOUR CAR SHOPPING SIDEKICK
Think of Otto as another set of eyes during one of the biggest purchases you will make.

Otto does the research. You make the decision.
- Scan it
- Research it
- Understand it
- Negotiate it

Download Otto and reveal the truth behind your next used car.

- - -

Otto offers a subscription that unlocks full access to advanced features and tools. Subscription options may include weekly or annual plans and will be clearly presented before purchase.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You
can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.

- - -

Research. Compare. Track. All in one place.

Explore 50+ peptides, ask AI with PubMed citations, compare compounds side by side, scan labels, and keep your research cycles, schedules, and logs organized with PepPal.

PepPal brings peptide research tools into one clean, easy-to-use app.

AI RESEARCH ASSISTANT
Ask peptide-related questions and get clear answers supported by peer-reviewed PubMed citations. Tap citations to view original studies and choose Simple, Moderate, or Detailed response styles.

50+ PEPTIDE PROFILES
Explore detailed profiles covering mechanisms of action, research context, half-lives, storage information, published literature, and other key research details.

SIDE-BY-SIDE COMPARISONS
Compare up to 4 peptides at once across key categories and research characteristics.

RESEARCH CYCLE TRACKER
Create custom research cycles, set schedules, record logged amounts, track frequency, and review your research history over time. Use reminders to stay organized and check off scheduled entries from your dashboard.

LABEL SCANNING
Scan peptide labels to quickly identify compounds and access relevant research information.

WELLNESS JOURNAL & TRENDS
Log sleep, energy, mood, recovery, training, and appetite. View trends over time alongside your research activity.

APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Optionally connect Apple Health to view steps, sleep, calories, and heart rate alongside your wellness data.

ADVANCED RESEARCH TOOLS
PepPal Elite unlocks additional tools, including:

• Blood Work Analysis — Review uploaded lab results and biomarker information
• COA Quality Analysis — Analyze Certificates of Analysis and reported purity information
• Compound Interaction Analyzer — Research potential interactions and overlaps between compounds
• Research Journal Patterns — Identify trends across your logged entries
• Sourcing Guidance — Review information related to vendors and product quality
• Expert Chat — Submit detailed research questions for additional guidance

CROSS-DEVICE SYNC
Sync your conversations, research cycles, logs, wellness data, account information, and subscription across iOS and the PepPal web app.

SIGN IN WITH APPLE
Quickly and securely access your account with Sign in with Apple.

PERSONALIZE PEPPAL
Customize your dashboard while using PepPal’s clean light and dark interfaces.

BUILT FOR PEPTIDE RESEARCH
Whether you’re reviewing published research, comparing compounds, organizing a research cycle, or tracking your findings, PepPal keeps your research tools in one place.

Research smarter. Stay organized. Keep everything in PepPal.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
PepPal offers free and paid plans with expanded AI access, research tools, tracking features, and advanced functionality. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled through your Apple ID settings.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
PepPal is intended for research and educational purposes only. PepPal does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or individualized healthcare guidance. Information provided through PepPal is for informational purposes and should not replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional. Users must be 18 years or older.

record.description_evidence:
PDF Search reads every word of every document you own and makes it findable in
the time it takes to type. Then it goes further: ask a question in plain words
and get an answer, with the exact pages it came from.

Built for people who live in documents: students, lawyers and researchers.


ASK YOUR DOCUMENTS ANYTHING

AI Chat answers questions about your library in plain language. Ask "can I end
my lease early?" and it searches your documents, reads the pages that matter,
and answers, citing the page each fact came from so you can check it yourself.

• Chat about your whole library, or the one document you are reading
• Every answer carries page references you can tap
• Conversations are saved, so you can pick one up later
• Runs on your device, or on Apple's Private Cloud Compute

AI Chat needs Apple Intelligence: an iPhone 15 Pro or later, or an iPad with an
M-series chip, running iOS 26 or later.


SEARCH THAT RANKS, NOT JUST MATCHES

Ordinary search tells you a word exists somewhere. PDF Search scores every page
on how well it answers you: where the words appear, how close together they
are, whether they land in a heading. The strongest pages come first.

• Results grouped by document, with every matching page and its rank
• Jump straight to the page, your words highlighted in context
• Search everything at once, or narrow to a folder or tag
• Export results to share or keep


LANGUAGE, NOT JUST LETTERS

Indexing uses tokenizing and lemmatization, so search understands the shape of
a word. Look for "hike" and find "hiking"; look for "children" and find
"child". Stems and near matches are covered too.


WORDS LOCKED IN PICTURES

Built-in text recognition reads photographed receipts, scanned contracts and
screenshots of slides, and adds every word to your index, so a picture of a
page is as searchable as the page itself. It covers every language your device
supports.

The built-in scanner turns paper documents, notes and cards into PDFs, reads
them as it goes, and files them with everything else, searchable from the
moment they land.


MORE THAN PDFS

Index PDFs alongside Microsoft Office documents (Word, PowerPoint), iWork files
(Pages, Keynote), rich text, plain text and logs, source code, and pages saved
from the web. Turn any format off to skip it.

• Folders on device or in iCloud, plus any folder or file you point the app at
• Tags, to cut across folders however you think
• Bookmarks with notes, gathered in one place across every document
• A document's table of contents, to move around a long file quickly
• Highlights and annotations while you read
• Index status at a glance: what is indexed, what is queued


YOUR MAC, IN YOUR POCKET

Run PDF Search on your Mac and sync over Wi-Fi with a single click. Documents
come across with their index intact, so your iPhone or iPad need not do the
work twice.


PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Indexing, text recognition and search happen on your device. No account, no
tracking, and purchases are verified on the device by the App Store.

The free version indexes and searches your documents and opens the top-ranked
result. Pro unlocks everything else:

• AI Chat, with page references
• Search inside images and scans
• Scan paper to PDF
• Plurals, stems and near matches
• Every ranked result, not just the first
• Export, tag and de-duplicate

one payment, yours for good, no renewals.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A
subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the
end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours of that.
Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. An unused part of a
free trial is forfeited when a subscription is bought.

record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
You already know how to invest. Now you'll have the research to back it up.

Thesis gives serious retail investors the same quality of stock research that institutional managers rely on — at a price that makes sense for individuals. Get your first report for less than a dollar.

——

THE RESEARCH GAP IS REAL

Institutional investors have access to deep equity research. Earnings transcript analysis. Valuation models. Bear case stress testing. Super investor position data. The kind of evidence base that makes a decision feel solid.

That research costs tens of thousands of dollars a year on platforms like Bloomberg or FactSet.

Until now, you were left with noise.


THESIS CLOSES THE GAP

Type any US stock ticker. Thesis runs a full 8-layer analysis — fundamental data, valuation models, earnings analysis, insider activity, super investor holdings, sentiment, macro context, and a built-in challenge to its own thesis — before it reaches a verdict.

The result: a structured research report with a clear recommendation (STRONG BUY to STRONG SELL), a conviction score, a calculated fair value, margin of safety, and a complete bear case.

Everything you need to make a decision you can stand behind.


HOW IT WORKS

1. Search your ticker — type any US stock symbol. If a fresh report exists, you get it instantly.

2. The analysis runs — if no fresh report exists, Thesis runs the full research pipeline. Ready in about 20 minutes. Watch it happen in real time or leave and get a push notification when it lands.

3. Read the report. Make your call — a structured verdict with conviction score, fair value, margin of safety, and the full bear case. Your decision to make.


WHAT'S IN A THESIS REPORT

· Recommendation: STRONG BUY / BUY / HOLD / SELL / STRONG SELL
· Conviction score (0–100%)
· Fair value estimate and margin of safety
· 8 independent evidence layers, each analysed before synthesis
· The bear case — what could go wrong, stated plainly
· Insider activity and super investor positioning
· Earnings transcript analysis
· Macro and sector context


YOUR WATCHLIST

Save tickers and see where each position stands at a glance — recommendation, conviction score, and when the research was last updated. Refresh any stock in one tap.


GET STARTED FOR LESS THAN A DOLLAR

Your first report costs less than a dollar. See what you've been missing.

Research only. Not financial advice. You make the decision.

Thesis is designed for US-listed equities. Reports are for informational purposes only and do not constitute financial advice.

ASK A QUESTION

Start with a simple question, a link, or text shared from another app. Choose Quick for a concise answer or Deep for a more detailed report.

See each stage of a Deep search as it moves from planning and finding sources to reading, cross-checking, and writing. Stop a search at any time, keep what was found, and try again with a sharper question.

READ WITH SOURCES

Explore executive summaries, key findings, detailed analysis, caveats, and inline citations. Open the original source, copy or share its link, save it, or ask a follow-up about it. Review source cards side by side when you want more context.

REFINE THE RESULT

Focus your search by time range, source type, region, language, and research depth. Continue the conversation with follow-up questions, search for new sources, verify again, or ask for a shorter or more detailed answer.

KEEP YOUR RESEARCH ORGANIZED

Save reports, pin important work, group it into collections, archive it, or move it to Trash. Search across past questions, answers, source titles, and links. Export a result as Markdown, plain text, or PDF when you want to share it.

BUILT FOR APPLE DEVICES

Use widgets, Live Activities, Apple Watch, Siri shortcuts, and the Share Extension to start or continue research where it is useful. Dictate a question, read an answer aloud, and pick the response language that fits your query.

Research history, drafts, settings, and saved results are stored on your device. When you run research, the submitted request to an AI service is processed to generate the answer and sources.

record.description_evidence:
Make your experience easier to understand—and easier to present. AI Resume brings resume writing, document design and interview preparation into one focused mobile workspace.

BUILD FROM YOUR REAL EXPERIENCE
Start manually, import a document, or share career notes with AI to create a structured first draft. Add experience, education, projects, skills, languages and the details that matter to your application. Save separate resumes and cover letters for different roles.

IMPROVE WITH CONTROL
Ask AI to improve a summary or experience, analyze the whole resume, suggest missing evidence, or tailor a separate copy to a job description. Review proposed changes before applying them and undo saved changes. AI can make mistakes; check every fact and never claim experience you do not have.

CHOOSE THE DOCUMENT, NOT JUST A NAME
Compare six distinct resume layouts using real document previews. Adjust the presentation and export multipage PDF, editable Word or plain text. Your content stays with you when you switch templates.

PRACTICE THE CONVERSATION
Choose a resume and optional job description for interview practice. Work through tailored questions, ask follow-ups, get specific feedback and revisit saved conversations. Continue practicing while your available AI allowance permits.

KEEP APPLICATIONS ORGANIZED
Track application stages, dates, notes and the resume version connected to each opportunity. Find, duplicate or archive documents as your search develops.

YOUR WORK, YOUR CHOICE
Documents and practice history are saved on your device. AI sends selected material to our secure service only after consent; it does not run on your device. Manual editing and previews work without AI. Report generated content directly in the app.

ACCESS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
An active subscription is required to use app features, including documents, templates, AI assistance, interview practice, application tracking and exports. You can complete onboarding, close the offer and browse the app before subscribing. Purchase, restore, legal, support and privacy controls remain available. AI requests have a monthly allowance and shared service-capacity limit; usage is shown in the app and is not unlimited. An internet connection is required for AI and store services. Subscription prices and any eligible introductory offer are shown by your store before purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your store account; restore purchases in Settings.

The app interface is in English.

Create a professional resume & tailored cover letter in minutes — AI-powered and private.
Resume AI Builder Pro gives you recruiter-ready CVs with designer templates, ATS-friendly exports, and on-device AI that keeps your data private.

What you can do

Fast resume creation — build from structured fields or free text using modern templates (Modern, Creative, Professional, Minimal).

AI cover letters on-device — Apple Foundation Models generate tailored cover letters without sending data off your device (no API key or internet required).

ATS-friendly PDF & Word export — print-ready, correctly paginated, and easy to share.

Add QR links — attach QR codes that point to your portfolio, LinkedIn, or website so employers can view your work instantly.

Fine-tune layout & typography — choose fonts, adjust margins, toggle profile photo or initials logo, and pick accent colors.

Smart import & parsing — auto-extract contact info, roles, dates, education, skills and custom sections from structured text.

Cover letter editor & preview — edit generated text, set fonts/margins, and create multi-page PDFs with precise pagination.

Flexible sections & defaults — prebuilt Contacts, About, Work, Education, Skills, Certifications and References — reorder or customize.

Why Resume AI Builder Pro?

Fast — spend minutes, not hours, formatting and polishing your CV.

Private — all AI generation and parsing happens locally on your device. Your data never leaves your phone.

Built for hiring — templates and exports are optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and real recruiter workflows.

Get started: enter your details, pick a template, generate a tailored cover letter, and export a professional PDF — all in a few taps.
